_readme: KPOT To Go — kitchen print agent settings.
Copy this file to config.json and fill in the values below.
Lines starting with _ are just notes; leave them alone.
You only HAVE to fill in printerHost. The website address is found
automatically (see discoveryUrl below), so you never have to update this
file again when the site is re-published.
printerHost  The printer's IP address on your shop network, e.g.
192.168.1.50. See PRINT-AGENT-SETUP.md for how to find it.
Do NOT use a name like 'EPSON123' — use the numbers.
printerPort  9100 for almost every network receipt printer. Only change
it if the printer's manual says otherwise.
printKey     The print agent's OWN key — SEPARATE from the admin/console
key. Set a printKey in the server's secrets.local.json (use a
DIFFERENT value from adminKey), then paste the SAME value here.
If the server has a printKey and this is wrong or empty, the
agent is rejected (401) and no tickets print. Only leave it
empty if the server has NO printKey and NO adminKey.
pollSeconds  How often to ask the server for new tickets. 2 is fine.
Lower feels snappier; it does not make printing faster.
discoveryUrl  Where to look up the website's CURRENT address. The site gets
a new address every time it is re-published, so hard-coding it
would mean editing this file on the shop PC after every deploy.
Instead the agent reads the address from the shop's own
redirect page. LEAVE THIS ALONE unless you know why you are
changing it.
Set it to "" (empty) to switch the lookup off and pin
serverUrl instead.
discoveryMinutes  How often to re-check for a new address. 5 is fine.
The agent also re-checks immediately if the site answers 400
or stops responding, so a re-publish heals itself.
serverUrl    OPTIONAL. Only used if the automatic lookup above fails, or if
you switched discoveryUrl off. Leave empty normally.
